route: Special work permit (Work Permit Act, 2023, s. 22)

permit.applies: The employer or employment agency, on behalf of a prospective employee, or an agent; the Minister issues it.
permit.first: The application in the First Schedule form with the documents of the Second Schedule and the prescribed non-refundable fee; registration with a professional body where the law requires one.
permit.eligibility: The Minister may issue a special work permit to non-citizen artists, performers, professional athletes, researchers and consultants who intend to work in Sierra Leone for a period not exceeding 3 months.

sources.title: The Work Permit Act, 2023 (Act No. 11 of 2023), SierraLII
sources.said: An application made by an employer or employment agency on behalf of a prospective employee or agent shall be endorsed with the full name, office address and stamp of the employer or employment agency. … a non-refundable application fee as prescribed by the Minister after consultation with the Work Permit Committee … The Minister may issue a special work permit to non-citizen artists, performers, professional athletes, researchers and consultants who intend to work in Sierra Leone for a period not exceeding 3 months.

note: The Work Permit Act, 2023 (Act No. 11 of 2023) on SierraLII is a scan without a text layer; sections 12, 18, 21 and 22 were read by eye from pages 11, 13 and 15 of the PDF rendered to images. Section 22 lets the Minister issue a special work permit to non-citizen artists, performers, professional athletes, researchers and consultants working in Sierra Leone up to 3 months; longer work takes the ordinary work permit. Fees are 'as prescribed by the Minister after consultation with the Work Permit Committee'; the Work Permit (Fees) Regulations 2024 exist on Parliament's site but parliament.gov.sl and nra.gov.sl fail certificate verification in this client (self-signed / unknown issuer), so they were not read. ECOWAS citizens work as nationals do (layer 3's ecowas list).
